desc: These Nature Valley Chewy Protein Granola Bars contain 10g of protein per serving, making them the perfect snack for the road ahead. These protein granola bars are made with peanuts, almonds, and an irresistible salted caramel bottom coating, bringing your taste buds along for a sweet and salty flavor explosion. Grab these convenient bars for snack time or an on-the-go invigorating treat. They're gluten free and made with no artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup. Nature Valley Chewy Granola Bars and perfect for the pantry, lunch box, or hiking trail. At Nature Valley, we believe that what you put in is what you get out. So wherever the moment takes you and your family, you can rely on our great-tasting snacks to help keep you going.
features:
CHEWY GRANOLA BARS: Protein Granola Bars made with peanuts, almonds, and a salted caramel bottom coating for the perfect balance of sweet and salty; Try them as tasty on-the-go snacks

PROTEIN: Contains 10g of protein per serving; An ideal snack to help keep you going

PERFECTLY PORTABLE: Convenient bars for snack time or an on-the-go invigorating treat; Perfect for the pantry, lunch box, and hiking trail

GREAT SNACK: Gluten-free snack with no artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup

CONTAINS: One 7.1 oz box of Nature Valley Chewy Salted Caramel Nut Protein Granola Bars; 5 bars
ingredients: Roasted Peanuts, Soy Protein Isolate, Almonds, Chicory Root Extract, Sugar, Vegetable Oils (palm, palm kernel, canola), Corn Syrup, Fructose, Vegetable Glycerin, Rice Starch, Whey Protein Concentrate, Nonfat Milk, Corn Starch, Soy Lecithin, Salt, Peanut Flour, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor.
